title: Use a flexible content width
summary: A box can use most of the available width while also having a maximum width.
introduction: A box can use most of the available width while also having a maximum width. Your task: Resize the page and watch the side space.
learningObjectives: Resize the page and watch the side space.
Explain the example for use a flexible content width

blocks.text: A box can use most of the available width while also having a maximum width. This avoids both cramped phones and very long lines.
Use the runnable HTML examples here, then resize a local browser page or its device preview. The CSS examples are inside each small page, so no framework is required.

blocks.title: Use a flexible content width

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `100% - 2rem` leaves a total of 2rem around the content.
`min(..., 60rem)` caps the width, and automatic inline margins share the extra space on both sides.

blocks.text: The main area has side space on narrow screens and stops growing after 60rem.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: A fixed width such as 1200px can overflow a phone. Use a flexible limit instead.
